description: This file defines a PHP trait `SphereRelationsTrait` that adds methods to manage 'sphere' relationships for a model class. It includes functions to add, replace, retrieve, and remove spheres associated with a model, as well as to get the main sphere. The trait interacts with a relational database table dynamically determined based on the model's table name.

methods.name: getSphereRelationalTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relational table used to link models with spheres, dynamically based on the model's table name.

methods.name: addSpheres
methods.description: Associates one or multiple spheres with the model, optionally removing other existing sphere relations.

methods.name: replaceSpheres
methods.description: Replaces current sphere associations with the provided spheres.

methods.name: getSpheres
methods.description: Retrieves all spheres associated with the current model, optionally in a specified language.

methods.name: removeSpheres
methods.description: Removes associations of specified spheres from the model.

methods.name: getMainSphere
methods.description: Returns the first (main) sphere associated with the model, if any.
